## Lightbox.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `items` :: Media items rendered in the viewer.
- `open` :: Whether the lightbox modal is open; bindable.
- `onOpenChange` :: Called when open state changes (backdrop click, Escape, close button).
- `index` :: Currently displayed zero-based slide index; bindable.
- `onIndexChange` :: Called when the active slide changes.
- `loop` :: Wrap navigation from last slide back to first and vice versa.
- `showThumbnails` :: Show clickable thumbnail preview row beneath the main slide.
- `showCounter` :: Show `current / total` counter in the top bar.
- `shape` :: The corner of the media, the counter chip, the caption and the thumbnails.
- `surface` :: The surface of the counter chip and the caption.
- `pad` :: The inset around the stage and its rows.
- `alignContent` :: How the stage's three rows are spread down the viewport.
- `textSize` :: Text scale of the counter and the caption.
- `size` :: The size of a thumbnail.
- `zoomButtonProps` :: Props forwarded to the zoom IconButton in the top bar.
- `closeButtonProps` :: Props forwarded to the close IconButton in the top bar.
- `prevButtonProps` :: Props forwarded to the previous-arrow IconButton at the left of the stage.
- `nextButtonProps` :: Props forwarded to the next-arrow IconButton at the right of the stage.
